rule_cards.title: Early Public Warning Protocol
rule_cards.guidance: Broadcast official evacuation advisories promptly when river forecasts suggest imminent bank overtopping. Early warnings give vulnerable families critical lead time to assemble emergency kits and move to higher ground.

rule_cards.title: Safe Shelter Operations
rule_cards.guidance: Designate and unlock multi-story masonry public buildings on elevated ground as relief shelters before evacuees arrive to ensure orderly intake and security.

rule_cards.title: Vehicle Safety in Floodwaters
rule_cards.guidance: Do not dispatch standard wheeled motor vehicles through roads with moving floodwaters deeper than knee level. Use boats or high-clearance specialized equipment when roads submerge.
rule_cards.source_reference: Transport and Road Safety Flooding Guidelines

rule_cards.title: Embankment Sandbagging Best Practices
rule_cards.guidance: Deploy sandbag barriers along low-lying bunds prior to the flood peak. Reinforcing bunds early slows down localized breaches and buys crucial hours for evacuation.

rule_cards.title: Keeping Shelters Supplied
rule_cards.guidance: Plan relief deliveries before shelter stocks run out. Shortages of food and essentials harm health and erode community trust in the response.

rule_cards.title: Safe Drinking Water After Floods
rule_cards.guidance: Floodwater contaminates wells and pipes. Setting up a supervised water purification point early in the recovery lowers the risk of waterborne illness for sheltered and returning families.

rule_cards.title: Health Monitoring and Medical Camps
rule_cards.guidance: Crowded shelters and standing water raise the chance of stomach and skin illness. A medical camp near the shelter helps detect and treat cases early, before they spread.

rule_cards.title: Return Home Only After Inspection
rule_cards.guidance: Residents should return only when their area is dry, the access road is open and houses have been checked for structural and electrical damage by the authorities.

rule_cards.title: Clearing Access and Restoring Services
rule_cards.guidance: Clear debris from access roads first so repair crews can reach substations and health facilities. Restoring power lets clinics and water pumps run again.

disclaimer: This is an educational simulation, not emergency guidance. FloodGuard is a simplified teaching simulation. Its water levels, outcomes and scores are invented and are not a flood forecast or a real-world plan. Characters are fictional and AI-generated text can be wrong. If you are in a real emergency or a flood is happening near you, stop playing and call 112 (India emergency number). Follow instructions from your local authorities and official sources for your area (for example the India Meteorological Department, the Central Water Commission and your State Disaster Management Authority). Do not rely on this simulation for decisions about evacuation, safety or health.
